description: This file defines the ResetPasswordDao class, which manages database operations related to password reset requests within an authentication plugin for the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving requests, retrieving logs by email or reset code, and updating the validity of reset password requests.

classes.name: ResetPasswordDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling password reset request persistence and retrieval within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin.

methods.name: saveResetPasswordRequest
methods.description: Persists a ResetPasswordRequest entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLogByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent ResetPasswordRequest associated with the specified email.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves the reset password request matching the provided reset code.

methods.name: updateResetPasswordValid
methods.description: Updates the 'expired' status of reset password requests for a given email.
